title: Adaptive shadow fusion with staged canary promotion and rollback mitigator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces an adaptive shadow->canary promotion flow with an automated rollback mitigator. Adds telemetry federation for fidelity scoring and a dry-run rollback planner for faster, safer reverts.
body:
Summary: This PR implements an adaptive 'shadow fusion' controller that continuously evaluates shadow traffic fidelity and can promote traffic slices to a staged canary when a multi-metric confidence threshold is met. It ships a 'rollback mitigator' subsystem that generates and validates dry-run rollback plans (snapshots + quick-rewind playbook) to reduce mean time to recover when regressions are detected. Motivation: Customers running shadow validations before canary promotion wanted fewer manual gating steps and faster recovery options. This change reduces manual toil, shortens promotion windows, and makes rollbacks reproducible and auditable.

What changed (high level):
- New controller: controller/promotion/shadow_fusion_controller.go — fusion logic evaluates grouped shadow traces, computes a fused fidelity score across latency/cls/semantic drift metrics, and coordinates staged promotions.
- Rollback mitigator: server/rollback/mitigator.go + docs/runbooks/rollback-mitigator.md — builds dry-run rollback plans, snapshots model pins, and verifies replays in a sandboxed dry-run.
- Telemetry federation: telemetry/federation_collector.go — aggregates short-lived session histograms from shadow lanes to compute cohort-level fidelity without sampling bias.
- Small API: api/rollouts/v1/promote.proto + api/rollouts/handlers.go — expose a PromotePreview endpoint that returns a promotion score and a precomputed rollback plan id.
- E2E tests: tests/e2e/shadow_fusion.spec.ts + tests/unit/mitigator_test.go — cover fusion scoring, smoke promotion, and rollback dry-runs.

Design notes and safety gates:
- Fusion scoring is ensemble-based: a weighted median of normalized metrics (p95 latency delta, token-level perplexity proxy, semantic embedding cosine drift, error-rate uplift). We enforce a quorum (>=3 of 4 metric bands must be within configured thresholds) to avoid single-metric flapping.
- Promotion is staged: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50%. Each stage requires the fusion score to remain above the acceptance threshold for a stability window (configurable; default 10 minutes).
- Rollback mitigator creates an immutable rollback plan (snapshot of model version, routing table, KV-cache checkpoint) and runs a dry-run replay in a sandbox. The mitigator scores the rollback plan for safety and time-to-recover and attaches cost/time estimates to the PromotePreview response.

Example usage (PromotePreview):
- Client: POST /v1/rollouts/preview with target model and cohort selector
- Response: {"fusion_score": 0.92, "quorum": true, "rollback_plan_id": "rb-20260218-89af", "estimated_recovery_minutes": 3}

Small code snippet (fusion heuristic):
- normalized := map[string]float64{"latency": norm(p95Delta), "perplexity": norm(ppDelta), "embed": norm(1-cosineDrift), "errors": norm(errorUplift)}
- scores := values(normalized)
- fusionScore := median(scores) * quorumFactor(scores, thresholds)

Testing and CI: All unit tests and e2e runs pass in the CI job. Added targeted flake-resistant tests that exercise time windows using the testclock in controller/testutil. CI job summary: build: pass, unit: pass, integration: pass, e2e: pass.

Rollout plan and observability:
- Default rollout policy uses the new fusion controller. Operators can opt out by setting annotation rollout.strategy=legacy.
- Console: new per-rollout panel (Console -> Rollouts) shows fusion score, contributing metrics, rollback plan id, and sandbox replay outcome.
- Alerts: two rule templates added: rollout-fusion-drop and rollback-mitigator-failure.

Backward compatibility and migration:
- No breaking API changes; new PromotePreview endpoint is additive.
- Existing rollouts remain on the stable promotion controller until annotated.

Risk and mitigation:
- Risk: improper weighting could bias promotions. Mitigation: default weights conservative, staged increases small, and PromotePreview surfaces the plan for manual review.
- Risk: rollback dry-run could be slow for very large models. Mitigation: mitigator supports fast-path lightweight snapshots and prioritizes KV/cache-less reverts when full snapshot is costly.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implementation of fusion controller and rollback mitigator
- [x] Unit tests for fusion heuristics and mitigator planner
- [x] E2E shadow->canary smoke tests
- [x] Console panel + runbook entry
- [x] Linear tasks updated (ENG-2345, ENG-9876)

Commits summary: see commit list.

Related work: builds on prior shadow-promote efforts but differs by producing an explicit, runnable rollback plan and scoring promotions with a fused, quorum-driven metric. Links: Linear/ENG-2345, Runbook link: docs/runbooks/rollback-mitigator.md

Notes for reviewers: focus on the fusion thresholds (controller/promotion/shadow_fusion_controller.go) and mitigator sandbox isolation (server/rollback/mitigator.go). The mitigator intentionally keeps the dry-run environment resource-limited to avoid noisy neighbour effects.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main after CI green and approvals.
commits: 3a8f2c1 - controller: add shadow_fusion_controller with ensemble scoring and quorum logic
9f4b7d0 - rollback: add mitigator planner, snapshot serializer, and sandbox dry-run harness
b6d5a77 - telemetry: federation collector + PromotePreview API + tests
review_comments: Raj Patel (reviewer): Could the quorum requirement be relaxed for low-traffic cohorts? Concerned about overfitting to noisy embedding signals.

Maya Chen (author): We added a per-cohort override — low-traffic cohorts use a longer stability window and a lower quorum threshold; documented in the controller config. Also added a unit test for the longer window behavior.
Elena Gomez (reviewer): The mitigator's sandbox needs a hard CPU/memory cap to avoid interfering with production. Where is that enforced?

Maya Chen (author): Sandbox limiter is enforced in server/rollback/sandbox_manager.go (new file) — it's configured via rollout.sandbox.* flags. I included the default caps in docs/runbooks/rollback-mitigator.md.
Ibrahim Noor (approver): Verified e2e smoke locally with the staging cluster; fusion scores behave as expected. Approving.
